            &quot;color&quot;: &quot;#00e387&quot;
          },
          &quot;avaliacao&quot;: {
            &quot;label&quot;: &quot;Avaliação&quot;,
            &quot;color&quot;: &quot;#d6453b&quot;
          }
        },
        &quot;events&quot;: []
      },
      &quot;images&quot;: {},
      &quot;carousels&quot;: {},
      &quot;enabled&quot;: true
    }
  }
}
</script>
<script>
/* ===========================================================================
   ░░ MODEL (MVC) ░░  Fonte única de verdade: o bloco <script id=&quot;asa-config&quot;>.
   Todo o conteúdo editável (perfis, integrações, cursos) vem daqui. O gerador
   edita esse JSON e regera os arquivos. NÃO edite os dados no código abaixo —
   eles apenas APONTAM para o CONFIG.
   =========================================================================== */
let CONFIG = JSON.parse(document.getElementById(&quot;asa-config&quot;).textContent);

/* ===========================================================================
   ░░ DADOS EDITÁVEIS ░░
   ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   SECTIONS_DATA → seções (sempre liberadas) e seus ITENS de conteúdo.
     Cada item: { id, title, doc, body }
       id ... identificador único (string) — usado para salvar o progresso
       title  → título do item (negrito)
       doc    → título do conteúdo/documento (linha de apoio)
       body   → conteúdo do item (aceita HTML: parágrafos, listas, links…)
   Para adicionar um conteúdo, copie um objeto de &quot;items&quot; e ajuste os campos.
   Para uma nova SEÇÃO, crie o <section> no HTML (com .step-list[data-section])
   e acrescente o objeto correspondente aqui.
   =========================================================================== */
/* Perfil de fallback: em códigos de 1 perfil só (gerados p/ o CRM) o perfil
   &quot;ingressantes&quot; pode não existir — então usamos o defaultProfile / 1º perfil. */
const _FALLBACK_PROFILE = CONFIG.profiles[CONFIG.defaultProfile]
  || CONFIG.profiles[Object.keys(CONFIG.profiles)[0]] || {};
const SECTIONS_DATA = (CONFIG.profiles.ingressantes||_FALLBACK_PROFILE).sections;

let ACTIVE_SECTIONS = SECTIONS_DATA;

/* CALENDAR_DATA → ver comentários dos campos no objeto de eventos abaixo. */
const CALENDAR_DATA = (CONFIG.profiles.ingressantes||_FALLBACK_PROFILE).calendar;

/* COURSES → nomes completos dos cursos (título dos selos no calendário). Edite à vontade;
   em cada evento, o campo `courses` lista os códigos exibidos no card. */
let COURSES = CONFIG.courses;

/* ===========================================================================
   ░░ UTILITÁRIOS ░░
   =========================================================================== */
const $=(s,c=document)=>c.querySelector(s);
const $$=(s,c=document)=>[...c.querySelectorAll(s)];
const MONTHS=[&quot;janeiro&quot;,&quot;fevereiro&quot;,&quot;março&quot;,&quot;abril&quot;,&quot;maio&quot;,&quot;junho&quot;,&quot;julho&quot;,&quot;agosto&quot;,&quot;setembro&quot;,&quot;outubro&quot;,&quot;novembro&quot;,&quot;dezembro&quot;];
const MONTHS_SHORT=[&quot;jan&quot;,&quot;fev&quot;,&quot;mar&quot;,&quot;abr&quot;,&quot;mai&quot;,&quot;jun&quot;,&quot;jul&quot;,&quot;ago&quot;,&quot;set&quot;,&quot;out&quot;,&quot;nov&quot;,&quot;dez&quot;];
const WEEK_SHORT=[&quot;Dom&quot;,&quot;Seg&quot;,&quot;Ter&quot;,&quot;Qua&quot;,&quot;Qui&quot;,&quot;Sex&quot;,&quot;Sáb&quot;];
const reduceMotion=window.matchMedia(&quot;(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)&quot;).matches;
function parseDate(s){const[y,m,d]=s.split(&quot;-&quot;).map(Number);return new Date(y,m-1,d);}
function fmtDate(s){const d=parseDate(s);return `${String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,&quot;0&quot;)} ${MONTHS_SHORT[d.getMonth()]} ${d.getFullYear()}`;}
function isoDay(d){return `${d.getFullYear()}-${String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,&quot;0&quot;)}-${String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,&quot;0&quot;)}`;}
function weekIndex(d){return d.getDay();}   // 0 = domingo
function escapeHtml(s){return String(s).replace(/[&amp;<>&quot;]/g,c=>({&quot;&amp;&quot;:&quot;&amp;amp;&quot;,&quot;<&quot;:&quot;&amp;lt;&quot;,&quot;>&quot;:&quot;&amp;gt;&quot;,'&quot;':&quot;&amp;quot;&quot;}[c]));}
const TODAY=new Date();
/* Mês de abertura do calendário: acompanha o mês corrente, mas nunca antes do
   mês inicial configurado nem depois do último mês que tem evento. */
function calStart(cal){
  const first=new Date(cal.defaultYear,cal.defaultMonth,1);
  const now=new Date(TODAY.getFullYear(),TODAY.getMonth(),1);
  let last=first;
  (cal.events||[]).forEach(e=>{ const s=e.endDate||e.date; if(!s)return;
    const d=parseDate(s), mm=new Date(d.getFullYear(),d.getMonth(),1); if(mm>last)last=mm; });
  if(now<first)return first;
  if(now>last)return last;
  return now;
}

/* ░░ ÍCONES reutilizáveis ░░ */
const ICONS={
  hand:'<path d=&quot;M7 11V6a2 2 0 0 1 4 0v5m0-1V4a2 2 0 0 1 4 0v7m0-2a2 2 0 0 1 4 0v5a6 6 0 0 1-6 6H10l-4-4a2 2 0 0 1 3-3l1 1&quot;/>',
  book:'<path d=&quot;M4 5h11a3 3 0 0 1 3 3v11&quot;/><path d=&quot;M4 5v14h11&quot;/>',
  life:'<circle cx=&quot;12&quot; cy=&quot;12&quot; r=&quot;9&quot;/><circle cx=&quot;12&quot; cy=&quot;12&quot; r=&quot;3.5&quot;/><path d=&quot;m5 5 3.5 3.5M19 5l-3.5 3.5M5 19l3.5-3.5M19 19l-3.5-3.5&quot;/>',
  calendar:'<rect x=&quot;3&quot; y=&quot;4&quot; width=&quot;18&quot; height=&quot;17&quot; rx=&quot;2&quot;/><path d=&quot;M3 9h18M8 2v4M16 2v4&quot;/>',
  check:'<path d=&quot;M20 6 9 17l-5-5&quot;/>',
  lock:'<rect x=&quot;4&quot; y=&quot;11&quot; width=&quot;16&quot; height=&quot;9&quot; rx=&quot;2&quot;/><path d=&quot;M8 11V8a4 4 0 0 1 8 0v3&quot;/>',
  chevron:'<path d=&quot;m6 9 6 6 6-6&quot;/>',
  clock:'<circle cx=&quot;12&quot; cy=&quot;12&quot; r=&quot;9&quot;/><path d=&quot;M12 8v4l3 2&quot;/>',
  pin:'<path d=&quot;M12 21s7-6.3 7-11a7 7 0 1 0-14 0c0 4.7 7 11 7 11z&quot;/><circle cx=&quot;12&quot; cy=&quot;10&quot; r=&quot;2.5&quot;/>',
  arrow:'<path d=&quot;M5 12h14M13 6l6 6-6 6&quot;/>'
};
const svg=(name,w=22,sw=2)=>`<svg viewBox=&quot;0 0 24 24&quot; width=&quot;${w}&quot; height=&quot;${w}&quot; fill=&quot;none&quot; stroke=&quot;currentColor&quot; stroke-width=&quot;${sw}&quot; stroke-linecap=&quot;round&quot; stroke-linejoin=&quot;round&quot;>${ICONS[name]||&quot;&quot;}</svg>`;

/* ░░ STORE — progresso (itens concluídos) em Local Storage ░░ */
let CAL_ACTIVE = CALENDAR_DATA;

const Store={
  KEY:&quot;asa.progress.v3&quot;, done:new Set(), ns:&quot;&quot;,
  load(){try{this.done=new Set(JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(this.KEY)||&quot;[]&quot;));}catch(e){this.done=new Set();}},
  save(){try{localStorage.setItem(this.KEY,JSON.stringify([...this.done]));}catch(e){}},
  is(id){return this.done.has(this.ns+id);},
  set(id,v){const k=this.ns+id;v?this.done.add(k):this.done.delete(k);this.save();},
  clear(){[...this.done].forEach(k=>{if(!this.ns||k.indexOf(this.ns)===0)this.done.delete(k);});this.save();}
};


/* ===========================================================================
   ░░ CONTENT CONTROLLER ░░
   Gera a navegação (seções sempre livres) e os ITENS de cada seção (stepper).
   Gating é POR SEÇÃO: o item N+1 libera quando o item N é concluído.
   =========================================================================== */
const Content={
  sections:[],          // { id, nav, icon, calendar?, items:[{...}], el, navBtn }
  itemsById:{},         // id -> { item, sectionId, indexInSection }

  init(){
    this.sections=ACTIVE_SECTIONS.map(s=>({...s, el:document.getElementById(s.id)}));
    this.buildNav();
    this.renderItems();
    this.bind();
    this.render();
  },

  totalItems(){return this.sections.reduce((n,s)=>n+s.items.length,0);},
  doneCount(){return Object.keys(this.itemsById).filter(id=>Store.is(id)).length;},

  // ---- Item liberado? (primeiro da seção, ou anterior concluído) ----
  isUnlocked(sectionId,index){
    if(index===0)return true;
    const prev=this.sections.find(s=>s.id===sectionId).items[index-1];
    return Store.is(prev.id);
  },

  /* ---- Componente: item de navegação (com progresso por seção) ---- */
  buildNav(){
    const nav=$(&quot;#nav&quot;);nav.innerHTML=&quot;&quot;;
    this.sections.forEach((s,i)=>{
      const b=document.createElement(&quot;button&quot;);
      b.className=&quot;nav__item&quot;;b.dataset.target=s.id;
      const hasItems=s.items.length>0;
      b.innerHTML=`<span class=&quot;nav__num&quot;>${s.calendar?svg(&quot;calendar&quot;,18):(i+1)}</span>
        <span class=&quot;nav__row&quot;><span class=&quot;nav__label&quot;>${escapeHtml(s.nav)}</span>
        ${hasItems?`<span class=&quot;nav__bar&quot;><i></i></span>`:``}</span>
        ${hasItems?`<span class=&quot;nav__count&quot;>0/${s.items.length}</span>`:``}`;
      b.addEventListener(&quot;click&quot;,()=>this.goTo(s.id));
      nav.appendChild(b);s.navBtn=b;
    });
  },

  /* ---- Componente: stepper de itens de uma seção ---- */
  renderItems(){
    this.itemsById={};
    this.sections.forEach(s=>{
      if(s.calendar)return;
      const host=document.getElementById(&quot;steps-&quot;+s.id);
      host.innerHTML=&quot;&quot;;
      s.items.forEach((it,idx)=>{
        this.itemsById[it.id]={item:it,sectionId:s.id,index:idx};
        const el=document.createElement(&quot;article&quot;);
        el.className=&quot;step-item&quot;;el.dataset.item=it.id;el.id=&quot;item-&quot;+it.id;
        el.innerHTML=`
          <button class=&quot;step-item__head&quot; aria-expanded=&quot;false&quot; aria-controls=&quot;body-${it.id}&quot;>
            <span class=&quot;step-item__num&quot;></span>
            <span class=&quot;step-item__titles&quot;><b>${escapeHtml(it.title)}</b><small>${escapeHtml(it.doc)}</small></span>
            <span class=&quot;step-item__aside&quot;>
              <span class=&quot;step-item__lock&quot;>${svg(&quot;lock&quot;,18)}</span>
              <span class=&quot;step-item__chev&quot;>${svg(&quot;chevron&quot;,20)}</span>
            </span>
          </button>
          <div class=&quot;step-item__body&quot; id=&quot;body-${it.id}&quot; role=&quot;region&quot;>
            <div class=&quot;step-item__content&quot;>
              <div class=&quot;doc-body&quot;>${it.body}</div>
            </div>
            <div class=&quot;step-item__actions&quot;>
              <label class=&quot;step-check&quot;>
                <input type=&quot;checkbox&quot; data-done=&quot;${it.id}&quot;>
                <span class=&quot;box&quot;>${svg(&quot;check&quot;,17,3)}</span>
                <span>Concluí este conteúdo</span>
              </label>
            </div>
          </div>`;
        host.appendChild(el);
      });
    });
  },

  bind(){
    // Expandir/recolher cabeçalhos
    $$(&quot;.step-item__head&quot;).forEach(head=>head.addEventListener(&quot;click&quot;,()=>{
      const el=head.closest(&quot;.step-item&quot;);const id=el.dataset.item;
      const{sectionId,index}=this.itemsById[id];
      if(!this.isUnlocked(sectionId,index)){return;}
      this.toggle(id,head.getAttribute(&quot;aria-expanded&quot;)!==&quot;true&quot;);
    }));
    // Confirmar leitura
    $$(&quot;[data-done]&quot;).forEach(inp=>inp.addEventListener(&quot;change&quot;,()=>{
      const id=inp.dataset.done;Store.set(id,inp.checked);
      if(!inp.checked)this.cascadeLock(id);
      this.render();
      if(inp.checked){this.advance(id);}
    }));
    // Restaura estado dos checkboxes
    $$(&quot;[data-done]&quot;).forEach(inp=>inp.checked=Store.is(inp.dataset.done));
  },

  // Abre/fecha um item (com animação de altura)
  toggle(id,open){
    const el=$(&quot;#item-&quot;+id);if(!el)return;
    const head=$(&quot;.step-item__head&quot;,el),body=$(&quot;.step-item__body&quot;,el);
    const isOpen=head.getAttribute(&quot;aria-expanded&quot;)===&quot;true&quot;;
    if(!open&amp;&amp;!isOpen)return;
    if(open&amp;&amp;isOpen){body.style.maxHeight=&quot;none&quot;;return;}
    head.setAttribute(&quot;aria-expanded&quot;,String(open));
    if(open){
      body.style.maxHeight=body.scrollHeight+&quot;px&quot;;
      const done=e=>{if(e.propertyName!==&quot;max-height&quot;)return;body.style.maxHeight=&quot;none&quot;;body.removeEventListener(&quot;transitionend&quot;,done);};
      body.addEventListener(&quot;transitionend&quot;,done);
    }else{
      body.style.maxHeight=body.scrollHeight+&quot;px&quot;;body.offsetHeight;body.style.maxHeight=&quot;0px&quot;;
    }
  },

  // Ao concluir um item, recolhe-o e abre o próximo liberado da MESMA seção
  advance(id){
    const{sectionId,index}=this.itemsById[id];
    const section=this.sections.find(s=>s.id===sectionId);
    this.toggle(id,false);
    const next=section.items[index+1];
    if(next){
      setTimeout(()=>{
        this.toggle(next.id,true);
        $(&quot;#item-&quot;+next.id).scrollIntoView({behavior:reduceMotion?&quot;auto&quot;:&quot;smooth&quot;,block:&quot;center&quot;});
      },260);
    }
  },

  // Desmarcar um item re-bloqueia (e recolhe) os seguintes da mesma seção
  cascadeLock(id){
    const{sectionId,index}=this.itemsById[id];
    const section=this.sections.find(s=>s.id===sectionId);
    for(let j=index+1;j<section.items.length;j++){
      Store.set(section.items[j].id,false);
      const inp=$(`[data-done=&quot;${section.items[j].id}&quot;]`);if(inp)inp.checked=false;
      this.toggle(section.items[j].id,false);
    }
  },

  goTo(id){
    closeDrawer();
    document.getElementById(id).scrollIntoView({behavior:reduceMotion?&quot;auto&quot;:&quot;smooth&quot;,block:&quot;start&quot;});
  },

  /* ---- Renderiza todos os estados (itens, nav, progresso) ---- */
  render(){
    // Itens
    this.sections.forEach(s=>{
      if(s.calendar)return;
      s.items.forEach((it,idx)=>{
        const el=$(&quot;#item-&quot;+it.id);const done=Store.is(it.id);const unlocked=this.isUnlocked(s.id,idx);
        const current=unlocked&amp;&amp;!done;
        el.classList.toggle(&quot;is-done&quot;,done);
        el.classList.toggle(&quot;is-locked&quot;,!unlocked);
        el.classList.toggle(&quot;is-current&quot;,current);
        const inp=$(&quot;[data-done]&quot;,el);inp.disabled=!unlocked;
        $(&quot;.step-item__num&quot;,el).innerHTML=done?svg(&quot;check&quot;,20,3):(idx+1);
        if(!unlocked){this.toggle(it.id,false);}
      });
    });

    // Navegação: progresso por seção
    this.sections.forEach(s=>{
      if(s.calendar)return;
      const total=s.items.length;const done=s.items.filter(it=>Store.is(it.id)).length;
      const complete=total>0&amp;&amp;done===total;
      s.navBtn.classList.toggle(&quot;is-complete&quot;,complete);
      const bar=$(&quot;.nav__bar i&quot;,s.navBtn);if(bar)bar.style.width=(total?done/total*100:0)+&quot;%&quot;;
      const cnt=$(&quot;.nav__count&quot;,s.navBtn);if(cnt)cnt.innerHTML=complete?svg(&quot;check&quot;,13,3):`${done}/${total}`;
      const num=$(&quot;.nav__num&quot;,s.navBtn);if(num&amp;&amp;complete)num.innerHTML=svg(&quot;check&quot;,18,3);
      else if(num&amp;&amp;!s.calendar)num.innerHTML=(this.sections.indexOf(s)+1);
    });

    // Contadores por seção (pílula no cabeçalho)
    $$(&quot;[data-count-for]&quot;).forEach(p=>{
      const s=this.sections.find(x=>x.id===p.dataset.countFor);if(!s)return;
      const done=s.items.filter(it=>Store.is(it.id)).length;const total=s.items.length;
      p.innerHTML=`${done===total?svg(&quot;check&quot;,15,3):svg(&quot;book&quot;,15)} ${done} de ${total} conteúdos concluídos`;
    });

    // Progresso geral
    const total=this.totalItems();const done=this.doneCount();const pct=Math.round(done/total*100);
    $(&quot;#ring&quot;).style.setProperty(&quot;--p&quot;,pct);$(&quot;#ring-pct&quot;).textContent=pct+&quot;%&quot;;
    $(&quot;#topbar-pct&quot;).textContent=pct+&quot;%&quot;;$(&quot;#topbar-ring&quot;).style.setProperty(&quot;--p&quot;,pct);
    $(&quot;#prog-count&quot;).textContent=`${done} de ${total} itens`;
    $(&quot;#hero-total&quot;).textContent=total;

  },

  setActive(id){this.sections.forEach(s=>s.navBtn.setAttribute(&quot;aria-current&quot;,String(s.id===id)));}
};

/* ===========================================================================
   ░░ CALENDAR CONTROLLER ░░ (mês/semana/dia + mini-calendário)
   =========================================================================== */
const Calendar={
  view:&quot;month&quot;,
  cursor:calStart(CAL_ACTIVE),
  selected:null,
  filters:{categories:new Set(),courses:new Set()},
  visible(e){return !e.availability || isoDay(TODAY)>=e.availability;},
  occurs(e,iso){return e.date<=iso &amp;&amp; iso<=(e.endDate||e.date);},
  byDay(iso){return CAL_ACTIVE.events.filter(e=>this.visible(e)&amp;&amp;this.occurs(e,iso)&amp;&amp;this.passes(e));},
  passes(e){const f=this.filters;if(f.categories.size&amp;&amp;!f.categories.has(e.category))return false;if(f.courses.size){const cs=e.courses||[];if(!cs.includes(&quot;Todos&quot;)&amp;&amp;!cs.some(c=>f.courses.has(c)))return false;}return true;},
  hasActiveFilters(){return this.filters.categories.size>0||this.filters.courses.size>0;},
  cat(k){return CAL_ACTIVE.categories[k]||{label:k,color:&quot;#00e387&quot;};},
  init(){
    $$(&quot;.cal__views button&quot;).forEach(b=>b.addEventListener(&quot;click&quot;,()=>this.setView(b.dataset.view)));
    $(&quot;#cal-prev&quot;).addEventListener(&quot;click&quot;,()=>this.shift(-1));
    $(&quot;#cal-next&quot;).addEventListener(&quot;click&quot;,()=>this.shift(1));
    this.renderFilters();this.render();this.renderMini();
  },
  reload(){
    this.filters.categories.clear();this.filters.courses.clear();
    this.view=&quot;month&quot;;$$(&quot;.cal__views button&quot;).forEach(b=>b.setAttribute(&quot;aria-pressed&quot;,String(b.dataset.view===&quot;month&quot;)));
    this.cursor=calStart(CAL_ACTIVE);this.selected=null;
    this.renderFilters();this.render();this.renderMini();
  },
  renderFilters(){
    const host=$(&quot;#cal-filters&quot;);if(!host)return;
    const cats=Object.entries(CAL_ACTIVE.categories).map(([k,c])=>
      `<button class=&quot;fchip&quot; data-group=&quot;categories&quot; data-val=&quot;${k}&quot; aria-pressed=&quot;false&quot;><span class=&quot;cal__dot&quot; style=&quot;background:${c.color}&quot;></span>${c.label}</button>`).join(&quot;&quot;);
    const allCourses=Object.keys(COURSES).filter(c=>c!==&quot;Todos&quot;);   // sempre TODOS os cursos cadastrados
    const courses=allCourses.map(c=>
      `<button class=&quot;fchip&quot; data-group=&quot;courses&quot; data-val=&quot;${c}&quot; aria-pressed=&quot;false&quot; title=&quot;${escapeHtml(COURSES[c]||c)}&quot;>${escapeHtml(c)}</button>`).join(&quot;&quot;);
    host.innerHTML=`<div class=&quot;cal__filter-group&quot;><span class=&quot;cal__filter-label&quot;>Categorias</span><div class=&quot;cal__filter-chips&quot;>${cats}</div></div>`
      +`<div class=&quot;cal__filter-group&quot;><span class=&quot;cal__filter-label&quot;>Cursos</span><div class=&quot;cal__filter-chips&quot;>${courses}</div></div>`
      +`<button class=&quot;cal__filter-clear&quot; id=&quot;cal-filter-clear&quot; hidden>Limpar filtros ✕</button>`;
    $$(&quot;.fchip&quot;,host).forEach(ch=>ch.addEventListener(&quot;click&quot;,()=>{
      const set=this.filters[ch.dataset.group],v=ch.dataset.val;
      set.has(v)?set.delete(v):set.add(v);
      ch.setAttribute(&quot;aria-pressed&quot;,String(set.has(v)));
      $(&quot;#cal-filter-clear&quot;).hidden=!this.hasActiveFilters();
      this.render();
    }));
    $(&quot;#cal-filter-clear&quot;).addEventListener(&quot;click&quot;,()=>{
      this.filters.categories.clear();this.filters.courses.clear();
      $$(&quot;.fchip&quot;,host).forEach(c=>c.setAttribute(&quot;aria-pressed&quot;,&quot;false&quot;));
      $(&quot;#cal-filter-clear&quot;).hidden=true;this.render();
    });
  },
  setView(v){this.view=v;$$(&quot;.cal__views button&quot;).forEach(b=>b.setAttribute(&quot;aria-pressed&quot;,String(b.dataset.view===v)));this.render();},
  shift(dir){
    if(this.view===&quot;month&quot;)this.cursor.setMonth(this.cursor.getMonth()+dir);
    else if(this.view===&quot;week&quot;)this.cursor.setDate(this.cursor.getDate()+7*dir);
    else this.cursor.setDate(this.cursor.getDate()+dir);
    this.render();
  },
  render(){this.view===&quot;month&quot;?this.renderMonth():this.view===&quot;week&quot;?this.renderWeek():this.renderDay();},

  renderMonth(){
    const y=this.cursor.getFullYear(),m=this.cursor.getMonth();
    const capMonth=MONTHS[m].charAt(0).toUpperCase()+MONTHS[m].slice(1);
    $(&quot;#cal-title&quot;).textContent=`${capMonth} ${y}`;
    const first=new Date(y,m,1),start=weekIndex(first);
    const daysInMonth=new Date(y,m+1,0).getDate(),prevDays=new Date(y,m,0).getDate();
    let cells=&quot;&quot;;
    for(let i=0;i<42;i++){
      let dn,cm=m,out=false;
      if(i<start){dn=prevDays-start+1+i;cm=m-1;out=true;}
      else if(i>=start+daysInMonth){dn=i-start-daysInMonth+1;cm=m+1;out=true;}
      else dn=i-start+1;
      const dObj=new Date(y,cm,dn),iso=isoDay(dObj),evs=this.byDay(iso),isToday=isoDay(TODAY)===iso;
      const dots=evs.slice(0,4).map(e=>`<span class=&quot;cal__dot&quot; style=&quot;background:${this.cat(e.category).color}&quot;></span>`).join(&quot;&quot;);
      cells+=`<button class=&quot;cal__day ${out?&quot;out&quot;:&quot;&quot;} ${isToday?&quot;today&quot;:&quot;&quot;} ${this.selected===iso?&quot;selected&quot;:&quot;&quot;}&quot; data-iso=&quot;${iso}&quot;>
        <span class=&quot;cal__daynum&quot;>${dn}</span>${evs.length?`<span class=&quot;cal__bar&quot;></span><span class=&quot;cal__dots&quot;>${dots}</span>`:&quot;&quot;}</button>`;
    }
    $(&quot;#cal-body&quot;).innerHTML=`<div class=&quot;cal__layout&quot;>
      <div class=&quot;cal__panel&quot;>
        <div class=&quot;cal__weekdays&quot;>${WEEK_SHORT.map(d=>`<span>${d}</span>`).join(&quot;&quot;)}</div>
        <div class=&quot;cal__grid&quot;>${cells}</div>
        <div class=&quot;cal__legend&quot;><span><i></i> Compromisso</span><span><i class=&quot;dot&quot;></i> Evento com data</span><span><i class=&quot;today&quot;></i> Hoje</span></div>
      </div>
      <div class=&quot;cal__events&quot;><h4 id=&quot;cal-events-title&quot;>Compromissos de ${MONTHS[m]}</h4><div class=&quot;cal__list&quot; id=&quot;cal-list&quot;></div></div></div>`;
    const ms=isoDay(new Date(y,m,1)),me=isoDay(new Date(y,m+1,0));const monthEvents=CAL_ACTIVE.events.filter(e=>this.visible(e)&amp;&amp;this.passes(e)&amp;&amp;e.date<=me&amp;&amp;(e.endDate||e.date)>=ms)
      .sort((a,b)=>a.date.localeCompare(b.date)||(a.start||&quot;&quot;).localeCompare(b.start||&quot;&quot;));
    this.renderList(monthEvents);
    $$(&quot;#cal-body .cal__day&quot;).forEach(btn=>btn.addEventListener(&quot;click&quot;,()=>{
      const iso=btn.dataset.iso;this.selected=this.selected===iso?null:iso;
      $$(&quot;#cal-body .cal__day&quot;).forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle(&quot;selected&quot;,b.dataset.iso===this.selected));
      if(this.selected){const evs=this.byDay(iso);
        $(&quot;#cal-events-title&quot;).textContent=evs.length?`Compromissos · ${fmtDate(iso)}`:`Sem compromissos · ${fmtDate(iso)}`;this.renderList(evs,iso);this.revealEvents();}
      else{$(&quot;#cal-events-title&quot;).textContent=`Compromissos de ${MONTHS[m]}`;this.renderList(monthEvents);}
    }));
  },

  // Feedback ao escolher um dia: realça o painel e o traz pra tela.
  // No desktop ele fica lado a lado e já está visível — nesse caso não rola nada.
  revealEvents(){
    const box=$(&quot;#cal-body .cal__events&quot;); if(!box) return;
    box.classList.remove(&quot;is-updated&quot;); void box.offsetWidth; box.classList.add(&quot;is-updated&quot;);
    const r=box.getBoundingClientRect();
    const vh=window.innerHeight||document.documentElement.clientHeight;
    if(r.top>vh*0.5) box.scrollIntoView({behavior:reduceMotion?&quot;auto&quot;:&quot;smooth&quot;,block:&quot;start&quot;});
  },

  eventCard(e, ctxIso){
    // ctxIso = dia que está sendo exibido (dia/semana ou dia selecionado no mês).
    // Em eventos de vários dias (com endDate), o selo mostra o DIA EM CONTEXTO,
    // não a data inicial — assim cada réplica mostra a data correta. Sem contexto, usa e.date.
    const c=this.cat(e.category),d=parseDate(ctxIso||e.date);
    const time=e.allDay?&quot;Dia todo&quot;:(e.start?`às ${e.start}`:&quot;&quot;);
    return `<article class=&quot;ev&quot; style=&quot;border-left-color:${c.color}&quot;>
      <div class=&quot;ev__date&quot;><b>${String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,&quot;0&quot;)}</b><small>${MONTHS_SHORT[d.getMonth()]}</small></div>
      <div class=&quot;ev__body&quot;>
        <span class=&quot;ev__cat&quot; style=&quot;background:${c.color}22;color:${c.color}&quot;><span class=&quot;cal__dot&quot; style=&quot;background:${c.color}&quot;></span>${c.label}</span>
        <h5>${escapeHtml(e.title)}</h5>
        ${e.professor?`<p class=&quot;ev__prof&quot;>${escapeHtml(e.professor)}</p>`:&quot;&quot;}
        <div class=&quot;ev__meta&quot;>${time?`<span>${svg(&quot;clock&quot;,13)} ${time}</span>`:&quot;&quot;}${e.local?`<span>${svg(&quot;pin&quot;,13)} ${escapeHtml(e.local)}</span>`:&quot;&quot;}</div>
        ${e.courses&amp;&amp;e.courses.length?`<div class=&quot;ev__courses&quot;><small>Disponível para</small><div class=&quot;ev__chips&quot;>${e.courses.map(cc=>`<span class=&quot;course-chip&quot; title=&quot;${escapeHtml(COURSES[cc]||cc)}&quot;>${escapeHtml(cc)}</span>`).join(&quot;&quot;)}</div></div>`:&quot;&quot;}
        ${e.link?`<a class=&quot;ev__link&quot; href=&quot;${escapeHtml(e.link)}&quot; target=&quot;_blank&quot; rel=&quot;noopener&quot;>Fazer inscrição ${svg(&quot;arrow&quot;,14)}</a>`:&quot;&quot;}
      </div></article>`;
  },
  renderList(list, ctxIso){const box=$(&quot;#cal-list&quot;);if(!box)return;
    box.innerHTML=list.length?list.map(e=>this.eventCard(e,ctxIso)).join(&quot;&quot;):`<p class=&quot;cal__empty&quot;>Nenhum compromisso neste período.</p>`;},

  renderWeek(){
    const base=new Date(this.cursor);base.setDate(base.getDate()-weekIndex(base));
    const days=[...Array(7)].map((_,i)=>{const d=new Date(base);d.setDate(base.getDate()+i);return d;});
    $(&quot;#cal-title&quot;).textContent=`${days[0].getDate()} ${MONTHS_SHORT[days[0].getMonth()]} – ${days[6].getDate()} ${MONTHS_SHORT[days[6].getMonth()]} ${days[6].getFullYear()}`;
    $(&quot;#cal-body&quot;).innerHTML=`<div class=&quot;cal__week&quot;>${days.map((d,i)=>{
      const iso=isoDay(d),evs=this.byDay(iso).sort((a,b)=>(a.start||&quot;&quot;).localeCompare(b.start||&quot;&quot;)),today=isoDay(TODAY)===iso;
      return `<div class=&quot;cal__weekcol ${today?&quot;today&quot;:&quot;&quot;}&quot;><h6>${WEEK_SHORT[i]}<b>${d.getDate()}</b></h6>
        ${evs.map(e=>{const c=this.cat(e.category);return `<span class=&quot;cal__pill&quot; style=&quot;background:${c.color}26;border-left-color:${c.color}&quot;><b>${e.allDay?&quot;Dia todo&quot;:(e.start||&quot;&quot;)}</b>${escapeHtml(e.title)}</span>`;}).join(&quot;&quot;)||`<span style=&quot;font-size:.7rem;color:#5fa98f&quot;>—</span>`}</div>`;
    }).join(&quot;&quot;)}</div>`;
  },
  renderDay(){
    const iso=isoDay(this.cursor);
    $(&quot;#cal-title&quot;).textContent=`${this.cursor.getDate()} de ${MONTHS[this.cursor.getMonth()]} de ${this.cursor.getFullYear()}`;
    const evs=this.byDay(iso).sort((a,b)=>(a.start||&quot;00:00&quot;).localeCompare(b.start||&quot;00:00&quot;));
    $(&quot;#cal-body&quot;).innerHTML=evs.length?`<div class=&quot;cal__panel&quot;><div class=&quot;cal__day-agenda&quot;>${
      evs.map(e=>`<div class=&quot;cal__agenda-row&quot;><time>${e.allDay?&quot;Dia todo&quot;:(e.start?(e.end?`${e.start}–${e.end}`:e.start):&quot;—&quot;)}</time><div>${this.eventCard(e,iso)}</div></div>`).join(&quot;&quot;)
    }</div></div>`:`<div class=&quot;cal__panel&quot;><p class=&quot;cal__empty&quot;>Nenhum compromisso neste dia.</p></div>`;
  },

  renderMini(){
    const box=$(&quot;#cal-mini&quot;),_ms=calStart(CAL_ACTIVE),y=_ms.getFullYear(),m=_ms.getMonth();
    const first=new Date(y,m,1),start=weekIndex(first),daysInMonth=new Date(y,m+1,0).getDate();
    let grid=WEEK_SHORT.map(d=>`<span>${d[0]}</span>`).join(&quot;&quot;);
    for(let i=0;i<start;i++)grid+=`<button class=&quot;out&quot; tabindex=&quot;-1&quot;></button>`;
    for(let dn=1;dn<=daysInMonth;dn++){const iso=isoDay(new Date(y,m,dn));
      grid+=`<button class=&quot;${isoDay(TODAY)===iso?&quot;today&quot;:&quot;&quot;} ${CAL_ACTIVE.events.some(e=>this.visible(e)&amp;&amp;this.occurs(e,iso))?&quot;has-ev&quot;:&quot;&quot;}&quot; data-iso=&quot;${iso}&quot; title=&quot;${fmtDate(iso)}&quot;>${dn}</button>`;}
    const upcoming=[...CAL_ACTIVE.events].filter(e=>this.visible(e)).sort((a,b)=>a.date.localeCompare(b.date))
      .filter(e=>parseDate(e.endDate||e.date)>=new Date(TODAY.getFullYear(),TODAY.getMonth(),TODAY.getDate())).slice(0,3);
    const nextHtml=(upcoming.length?upcoming:CAL_ACTIVE.events.slice(0,3)).map(e=>{const c=this.cat(e.category);
      return `<a class=&quot;cal-mini__ev&quot; href=&quot;#calendario&quot; data-iso=&quot;${e.date}&quot;><i style=&quot;background:${c.color}&quot;></i>
        <span><b>${escapeHtml(e.title.length>34?e.title.slice(0,32)+&quot;…&quot;:e.title)}</b><small>${fmtDate(e.date)}${e.start?` · ${e.start}`:&quot;&quot;}</small></span></a>`;}).join(&quot;&quot;);
    box.innerHTML=`<div class=&quot;cal-mini__head&quot;><b>${MONTHS[m].charAt(0).toUpperCase()+MONTHS[m].slice(1)} ${y}</b></div>
      <div class=&quot;cal-mini__grid&quot;>${grid}</div><div class=&quot;cal-mini__next&quot;>${nextHtml}</div>
      <a class=&quot;cal-mini__link&quot; href=&quot;#calendario&quot;>Ver calendário completo →</a>`;
    $$(&quot;#cal-mini [data-iso]&quot;).forEach(el=>el.addEventListener(&quot;click&quot;,ev=>{
      ev.preventDefault();closeDrawer();this.setView(&quot;month&quot;);this.selected=el.dataset.iso;
      const d=parseDate(el.dataset.iso);this.cursor=new Date(d.getFullYear(),d.getMonth(),1);this.render();
      $(&quot;#calendario&quot;).scrollIntoView({behavior:reduceMotion?&quot;auto&quot;:&quot;smooth&quot;});
    }));
  }
};

/* ===========================================================================
   ░░ NAV / DRAWER · SCROLLSPY · REVEAL · HERO CANVAS ░░
   =========================================================================== */
function openDrawer(){document.body.classList.add(&quot;nav-open&quot;);$(&quot;#hamburger&quot;).setAttribute(&quot;aria-expanded&quot;,&quot;true&quot;);$(&quot;#backdrop&quot;).hidden=false;}
function closeDrawer(){document.body.classList.remove(&quot;nav-open&quot;);$(&quot;#hamburger&quot;).setAttribute(&quot;aria-expanded&quot;,&quot;false&quot;);$(&quot;#backdrop&quot;).hidden=true;}
$(&quot;#hamburger&quot;).addEventListener(&quot;click&quot;,()=>document.body.classList.contains(&quot;nav-open&quot;)?closeDrawer():openDrawer());
$(&quot;#backdrop&quot;).addEventListener(&quot;click&quot;,closeDrawer);
document.addEventListener(&quot;keydown&quot;,e=>{if(e.key===&quot;Escape&quot;)closeDrawer();});

function initScrollSpy(){
  const root=document.querySelector(&quot;.main&quot;)||null;   // conteúdo rola dentro de .main
  const obs=new IntersectionObserver(es=>es.forEach(e=>{if(e.isIntersecting)Content.setActive(e.target.id);}),
    {root,rootMargin:&quot;-45% 0px -50% 0px&quot;,threshold:0});
  $$(&quot;.lp-section&quot;).forEach(s=>obs.observe(s));
}
function initReveal(){
  if(reduceMotion){$$(&quot;.reveal&quot;).forEach(el=>el.classList.add(&quot;in&quot;));return;}
  const root=document.querySelector(&quot;.main&quot;)||null;
  const obs=new IntersectionObserver(es=>es.forEach(e=>{if(e.isIntersecting){e.target.classList.add(&quot;in&quot;);obs.unobserve(e.target);}}),{root,threshold:.14});
  $$(&quot;.reveal&quot;).forEach(el=>obs.observe(el));
}
function initHeroCanvas(){ /* animação removida — Hermes permanece como marca estática */ }

/* ░░ Ações diversas ░░ */
$(&quot;#year&quot;).textContent=new Date().getFullYear();

/* ===========================================================================
   ░░ ACHE SEU RA (Power Automate) ░░
   O fluxo HTTP recebe o CPF e devolve o RA. O RA fica em cache (localStorage)
   para não chamar o fluxo de novo. Contrato do fluxo: ver README.
   --- CONFIGURE A URL DO FLUXO AQUI (ou a base64 em urlB64) ---
   =========================================================================== */
let RA_FLOW = CONFIG.integrations.ra;
function _raUrl(){ if(RA_FLOW.url) return RA_FLOW.url; if(RA_FLOW.urlB64){ try{ return atob(RA_FLOW.urlB64); }catch(e){} } return &quot;&quot;; }
function _digits(s){ return (s||&quot;&quot;).replace(/\D/g,&quot;&quot;); }
function _cpfMask(d){ d=d.slice(0,11);
  if(d.length>9) return d.slice(0,3)+&quot;.&quot;+d.slice(3,6)+&quot;.&quot;+d.slice(6,9)+&quot;-&quot;+d.slice(9);
  if(d.length>6) return d.slice(0,3)+&quot;.&quot;+d.slice(3,6)+&quot;.&quot;+d.slice(6);
  if(d.length>3) return d.slice(0,3)+&quot;.&quot;+d.slice(3);
  return d; }
function _raCache(){ try{ return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(RA_FLOW.cacheKey)||&quot;{}&quot;); }catch(e){ return {}; } }
function _raCacheSet(cpf,ra){ try{ const c=_raCache(); c[cpf]=ra; localStorage.setItem(RA_FLOW.cacheKey,JSON.stringify(c)); }catch(e){} }
function _lastRa(){ const c=_raCache(); const k=Object.keys(c); return k.length?c[k[k.length-1]]:&quot;&quot;; }
function _prefillRa(ra){ const i=document.getElementById(&quot;pcd-ra&quot;); if(i&amp;&amp;!i.value) i.value=ra; }
function initRaFinder(){
  const form=$(&quot;#ra-form&quot;); if(!form) return;
  const input=$(&quot;#ra-cpf&quot;), result=$(&quot;#ra-result&quot;), btn=form.querySelector(&quot;button&quot;);
  const show=(cls,html)=>{ result.hidden=false; result.className=&quot;ra-finder__result &quot;+cls; result.innerHTML=html; };
  const showRa=(ra,cached)=>{ show(&quot;is-ok&quot;,&quot;Seu RA é <b>&quot;+escapeHtml(ra)+&quot;</b>&quot;+(cached?&quot; <small>(salvo neste navegador)</small>&quot;:&quot;&quot;)+' <button type=&quot;button&quot; class=&quot;ra-finder__copy&quot; data-ra=&quot;'+escapeHtml(ra)+'&quot;>copiar</button>'); _prefillRa(ra); try{fillRaUser(ra);}catch(e){} };
  // Mensagem ÚNICA para qualquer falha na busca do RA: orienta o aluno a falar com a ASA
  // no WhatsApp (com a mensagem já preenchida). Telefone e texto ficam aqui para fácil edição.
  const WA_PHONE=CONFIG.integrations.whatsapp.phone;
  const WA_TEXT=CONFIG.integrations.whatsapp.text;
  const _waLink=()=>&quot;https://api.whatsapp.com/send?phone=&quot;+WA_PHONE+&quot;&amp;text=&quot;+encodeURIComponent(WA_TEXT);
  const showErr=()=> show(&quot;is-err&quot;,'CPF não encontrado. Entre em contato com a ASA pelo <a class=&quot;ra-finder__wa&quot; href=&quot;'+_waLink()+'&quot; target=&quot;_blank&quot; rel=&quot;noopener&quot;><svg viewBox=&quot;0 0 24 24&quot; fill=&quot;currentColor&quot; aria-hidden=&quot;true&quot;><path d=&quot;M.057 24l1.687-6.163a11.867 11.867 0 01-1.587-5.946C.16 5.335 5.495 0 12.05 0a11.817 11.817 0 018.413 3.488 11.824 11.824 0 013.48 8.414c-.003 6.557-5.338 11.892-11.893 11.892a11.9 11.9 0 01-5.688-1.448L.057 24zm6.597-3.807c1.676.995 3.276 1.591 5.392 1.592 5.448 0 9.886-4.434 9.889-9.885.002-5.462-4.415-9.89-9.881-9.892-5.452 0-9.887 4.434-9.889 9.884a9.86 9.86 0 001.51 5.26l-.999 3.648 3.748-.985zm11.387-5.464c-.074-.124-.272-.198-.57-.347-.297-.149-1.758-.868-2.031-.967-.272-.099-.47-.149-.669.149-.198.297-.768.967-.941 1.165-.173.198-.347.223-.644.074-.297-.149-1.255-.462-2.39-1.475-.883-.788-1.48-1.761-1.653-2.059-.173-.297-.018-.458.13-.606.134-.133.297-.347.446-.521.151-.172.2-.296.3-.495.099-.198.05-.372-.025-.521-.075-.148-.669-1.611-.916-2.206-.242-.579-.487-.501-.669-.51l-.57-.01c-.198 0-.52.074-.792.372s-1.04 1.016-1.04 2.479 1.065 2.876 1.213 3.074c.149.198 2.095 3.2 5.076 4.487.709.306 1.263.489 1.694.626.712.226 1.36.194 1.872.118.571-.085 1.758-.719 2.006-1.413.248-.695.248-1.29.173-1.414z&quot;/></svg>WhatsApp</a>');
  input.addEventListener(&quot;input&quot;,()=>{ input.value=_cpfMask(_digits(input.value)); });
  result.addEventListener(&quot;click&quot;,e=>{ const c=e.target.closest(&quot;.ra-finder__copy&quot;); if(c){ try{navigator.clipboard.writeText(c.dataset.ra);}catch(e){} c.textContent=&quot;copiado!&quot;; } });
  form.addEventListener(&quot;submit&quot;, async e=>{
    e.preventDefault();
    const cpf=_digits(input.value);
    if(cpf.length!==11){ show(&quot;is-err&quot;,&quot;Digite um CPF válido (11 números).&quot;); return; }
    const cache=_raCache();
    if(cache[cpf]){ showRa(cache[cpf],true); return; }   // cache → sem chamada ao fluxo
    const url=_raUrl();
    if(!url){ showErr(); return; }
    btn.disabled=true; show(&quot;is-loading&quot;,&quot;Consultando…&quot;);
    try{
      // O gatilho do fluxo é GET: o CPF vai como parâmetro de URL (?cpf=...).
      // A URL do Power Automate já tem query string (sig, api-version…), então anexamos com &quot;&amp;&quot;.
      const sep=url.indexOf(&quot;?&quot;)>=0?&quot;&amp;&quot;:&quot;?&quot;;
      const r=await fetch(url+sep+&quot;cpf=&quot;+encodeURIComponent(cpf),{method:&quot;GET&quot;});
      if(!r.ok){ showErr(); return; }
      const data=await r.json().catch(()=>({}));
      const ra=(data&amp;&amp;(data.ra||data.RA||data.registroAcademico))||&quot;&quot;;
      if(ra){ _raCacheSet(cpf,ra); showRa(ra,false); }
      else showErr();
    }catch(err){ showErr(); }
    finally{ btn.disabled=false; }
  });
}

/* ░░ INIT ░░ */
/* ===========================================================================
   ░░ EXPERIÊNCIAS (Ingressantes / Veteranos) ░░
   Cada experiência tem: hero (textos do topo), sections (mesmo formato de
   SECTIONS_DATA, com `head` para o cabeçalho) e calendar (formato CALENDAR_DATA).
   INGRESSANTES reusa SECTIONS_DATA / CALENDAR_DATA (já existentes acima).
   Edite o bloco de VETERANOS abaixo livremente.
   =========================================================================== */
const SECTIONS_DATA_VET = (CONFIG.profiles.veteranos||{}).sections;
const CALENDAR_DATA_VET = (CONFIG.profiles.veteranos||{}).calendar;
/* ----- CIÊNCIAS CONTÁBEIS PARA GRADUADOS (5º–8º sem) — EXEMPLO, edite ----- */
const SECTIONS_DATA_CG = (CONFIG.profiles[&quot;contabeis-graduados&quot;]||{}).sections;
const CALENDAR_DATA_CG = (CONFIG.profiles[&quot;contabeis-graduados&quot;]||{}).calendar;

/* ----- TRANSFERÊNCIA EXTERNA (1º sem) + CCG DIREITO (4º sem) — EXEMPLO, edite ----- */
const SECTIONS_DATA_TE = (CONFIG.profiles[&quot;transferencia-externa&quot;]||{}).sections;
const CALENDAR_DATA_TE = (CONFIG.profiles[&quot;transferencia-externa&quot;]||{}).calendar;

let EXPERIENCES = CONFIG.profiles;

/* ----- Render por experiência ----- */
function expRenderHero(hero, nSec){
  const inner=document.getElementById(&quot;hero-inner&quot;); if(!inner) return;
  inner.innerHTML =
    `<p class=&quot;eyebrow&quot;>${escapeHtml(hero.eyebrow||&quot;&quot;)}</p>
     <h1 class=&quot;display&quot;>${escapeHtml(hero.title||&quot;&quot;)}</h1>
     <p class=&quot;lead&quot;>${hero.lead||&quot;&quot;}</p>
     <div class=&quot;hero__meta&quot;>
       <span class=&quot;chip&quot;><svg viewBox=&quot;0 0 24 24&quot; fill=&quot;none&quot; stroke=&quot;currentColor&quot; stroke-width=&quot;2&quot;><path d=&quot;M4 6h16M4 12h16M4 18h10&quot;/></svg> ${nSec} seções</span>
       <span class=&quot;chip&quot;><svg viewBox=&quot;0 0 24 24&quot; fill=&quot;none&quot; stroke=&quot;currentColor&quot; stroke-width=&quot;2&quot;><path d=&quot;M20 6 9 17l-5-5&quot;/></svg> <span id=&quot;hero-total&quot;>0</span> conteúdos</span>
       <span class=&quot;chip&quot;><svg viewBox=&quot;0 0 24 24&quot; fill=&quot;none&quot; stroke=&quot;currentColor&quot; stroke-width=&quot;2&quot;><circle cx=&quot;12&quot; cy=&quot;12&quot; r=&quot;9&quot;/><path d=&quot;M12 8v4l3 2&quot;/></svg> Progresso salvo</span>
     </div>`;
}
function expRenderSections(sections){
  const host=document.getElementById(&quot;sections-host&quot;); if(!host) return;
  host.innerHTML = sections.filter(s=>!s.calendar).map(s=>{
    const hd=s.head||{};
    return `<section class=&quot;lp-section&quot; id=&quot;${s.id}&quot;>
      <div class=&quot;section-head&quot;>
        ${hd.eyebrow?`<p class=&quot;eyebrow&quot;>${escapeHtml(hd.eyebrow)}</p>`:&quot;&quot;}
        <h2 class=&quot;display&quot;>${escapeHtml(hd.title||s.nav)}</h2>
        ${hd.lead?`<p class=&quot;lead&quot;>${hd.lead}</p>`:&quot;&quot;}
        <span class=&quot;count-pill&quot; data-count-for=&quot;${s.id}&quot;></span>
      </div>
      <div class=&quot;step-list&quot; id=&quot;steps-${s.id}&quot; data-section=&quot;${s.id}&quot;></div>
    </section>`;
  }).join(&quot;&quot;);
}
function expUpdateCalHead(sections){
  const cal=sections.find(s=>s.calendar)||{}, hd=cal.head||{};
  const set=(id,html)=>{const el=document.getElementById(id); if(el) el.innerHTML=html;};
  set(&quot;cal-eyebrow&quot;, escapeHtml(hd.eyebrow||&quot;Organize-se&quot;));
  set(&quot;cal-head-title&quot;, escapeHtml(hd.title||&quot;Calendário acadêmico&quot;));
  set(&quot;cal-lead&quot;, hd.lead||&quot;&quot;);
  const link=document.getElementById(&quot;cal-fulllink&quot;);
  if(link){ if(hd.fullUrl){ link.href=hd.fullUrl; link.textContent=hd.fullLabel||&quot;Acessar o Calendário Acadêmico completo&quot;; link.style.display=&quot;&quot;; } else { link.style.display=&quot;none&quot;; } }
}
function expRenderFooter(sections){
  const host=document.getElementById(&quot;footer-sections&quot;); if(!host) return;
  host.innerHTML = sections.map(s=>`<a href=&quot;#${s.id}&quot;>${escapeHtml(s.nav)}</a>`).join(&quot;&quot;);
}

/* ----- Visual do portão por perfil (gradiente de fundo + tonalização) ----- */
let EXP_GATE_VIS = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(CONFIG.profiles).map(([k,p])=>[k,p.gate||{}]));

/* ----- Controlador de experiência + portão de entrada ----- */
const ExpCtrl = {
  KEY:&quot;asa.audience.v1&quot;, current:null,
  init(){
    let a=null; try{ a=localStorage.getItem(this.KEY); }catch(e){}
    this.buildGate();
    const btn=document.getElementById(&quot;exp-change&quot;);
    if(btn) btn.addEventListener(&quot;click&quot;,()=>this.openGate());
    document.addEventListener(&quot;keydown&quot;,e=>{
      if(e.key===&quot;Escape&quot; &amp;&amp; this.current){ const g=document.getElementById(&quot;exp-gate&quot;); if(g &amp;&amp; !g.hidden) this.closeGate(); }
    });
    const en=this.enabledIds();
    const def=en.includes(CONFIG.defaultProfile)?CONFIG.defaultProfile:(en[0]||Object.keys(EXPERIENCES)[0]);
    if(EXPERIENCES[a] &amp;&amp; EXPERIENCES[a].enabled!==false){ this.apply(a); this.closeGate(); } // já escolheu (e ainda ativo)
    else if(en.length<=1){ this.apply(def); this.closeGate(); }   // 0/1 perfil ativo → entra direto
    else { this.apply(def); this.openGate(); }                    // 1ª visita → portão
  },
  enabledIds(){ return Object.keys(EXPERIENCES).filter(k=>EXPERIENCES[k] &amp;&amp; EXPERIENCES[k].enabled!==false); },
  buildGate(){
    const host=document.getElementById(&quot;exp-gate-cards&quot;); if(!host) return;
    host.innerHTML = Object.entries(EXPERIENCES).filter(([k,e])=>e.enabled!==false).map(([k,e])=>{
      const vis=EXP_GATE_VIS[k]||{};
      const cover=e.cover?`url(&quot;${e.cover}&quot;)`:&quot;none&quot;;
      return `<button class=&quot;exp-gate__card&quot; type=&quot;button&quot; data-exp=&quot;${k}&quot; aria-label=&quot;${escapeHtml(e.label)}&quot;
        style=&quot;--cover-fallback:${vis.fallback||'#0a4a38'};--cover:${cover};--tint:${vis.tint||'rgba(2,51,39,.7)'}&quot;>
        <span class=&quot;exp-gate__cardbg&quot;></span><span class=&quot;exp-gate__tint&quot;></span>
        <span class=&quot;exp-gate__body&quot;>
          <span class=&quot;exp-gate__ico&quot;>${vis.icon||''}</span>
          <b>${escapeHtml(e.label)}</b>
          <p>${escapeHtml(e.desc||'').replace(/(\d+º)\s+/g,'$1 ').replace(/\n/g,'<br>')}</p>
          <span class=&quot;exp-gate__cta&quot;>Entrar ${svg(&quot;arrow&quot;,16)}</span>
        </span></button>`;
    }).join(&quot;&quot;);
    host.querySelectorAll(&quot;.exp-gate__card&quot;).forEach(b=>b.addEventListener(&quot;click&quot;,()=>this.choose(b.dataset.exp)));
  },
  choose(id){
    if(!EXPERIENCES[id] || EXPERIENCES[id].enabled===false) return;
    try{ localStorage.setItem(this.KEY,id); }catch(e){}
    if(id!==this.current) this.apply(id);
    this.closeGate();
  },
  openGate(){
    const g=document.getElementById(&quot;exp-gate&quot;); if(!g) return;
    this.markGate(); g.hidden=false;
    document.documentElement.classList.add(&quot;exp-gate-open&quot;);
    document.body.classList.add(&quot;exp-gate-open&quot;);
  },
  closeGate(){
    const g=document.getElementById(&quot;exp-gate&quot;); if(!g) return;
    g.hidden=true;
    document.documentElement.classList.remove(&quot;exp-gate-open&quot;);
    document.body.classList.remove(&quot;exp-gate-open&quot;);
  },
  markGate(){ document.querySelectorAll(&quot;#exp-gate-cards .exp-gate__card&quot;).forEach(b=>b.setAttribute(&quot;aria-current&quot;,String(b.dataset.exp===this.current))); },
  apply(id){
    const exp=EXPERIENCES[id]; if(!exp) return;
    this.current=id;
    Store.ns = id + &quot;::&quot;;
    CAL_ACTIVE = exp.calendar;
    ACTIVE_SECTIONS = exp.sections;
    expRenderHero(exp.hero, exp.sections.filter(s=>!s.calendar).length);
    expRenderSections(exp.sections);
    expUpdateCalHead(exp.sections);
    Content.init();
    Calendar.reload();
    expRenderFooter(exp.sections);
    const lbl=document.getElementById(&quot;exp-current-label&quot;); if(lbl) lbl.textContent=exp.label;
    const only=this.enabledIds().length<=1;
    const bar=document.getElementById(&quot;exp-current&quot;); if(bar) bar.hidden=only;
    const chg=document.getElementById(&quot;exp-change&quot;); if(chg) chg.style.display=only?&quot;none&quot;:&quot;&quot;;
    try{ fillRaUser(); fillImgSlots(exp); fillCarousels(exp); }catch(e){}
  }
};

/* RA do aluno no conteúdo: mostra o RA localizado pelo CPF, ou orienta a buscar */
function fillRaUser(ra){
  // O RA só aparece após uma busca ATIVA (arg vindo do localizador). Sem busca,
  // NÃO usa cache — mostra a orientação (evita exibir o RA de outro aluno).
  ra = ra || &quot;&quot;;
  document.querySelectorAll(&quot;[data-ra-user]&quot;).forEach(el=>{
    if(ra){ el.textContent=ra; el.classList.remove(&quot;ra-user--empty&quot;); }
    else { el.innerHTML='localize seu RA pelo CPF no card <b>\u201CNão sabe seu RA?\u201D</b> acima'; el.classList.add(&quot;ra-user--empty&quot;); }
  });
}
/* Slots de imagem (preenchidos pelo editor, via perfil.images) */
function fillImgSlots(exp){
  const imgs=(exp&amp;&amp;exp.images)||{};
  document.querySelectorAll(&quot;.step-item__content [data-img]&quot;).forEach(el=>{
    const url=imgs[el.getAttribute(&quot;data-img&quot;)], cap=el.getAttribute(&quot;data-cap&quot;)||&quot;&quot;;
    if(url){ el.classList.add(&quot;has-img&quot;); el.innerHTML='<img src=&quot;'+encodeURI(url)+'&quot; alt=&quot;'+escapeHtml(cap)+'&quot; loading=&quot;lazy&quot;>'; }
    else { el.classList.remove(&quot;has-img&quot;); el.textContent=cap||&quot;Imagem&quot;; }
  });
}
/* Seletor interativo (.chooser) — troca o painel conforme a escolha */
document.addEventListener(&quot;click&quot;, function(e){
  const btn=e.target.closest(&quot;.chooser [data-go]&quot;); if(!btn) return;
  const ch=btn.closest(&quot;.chooser&quot;), grp=ch.getAttribute(&quot;data-grp&quot;)||&quot;&quot;, go=btn.getAttribute(&quot;data-go&quot;);
  const scope=ch.closest(&quot;.step-item__content&quot;)||document;
  ch.querySelectorAll(&quot;[data-go]&quot;).forEach(b=>b.setAttribute(&quot;aria-pressed&quot;, b===btn?&quot;true&quot;:&quot;false&quot;));
  scope.querySelectorAll('.chooser-panel[data-grp=&quot;'+grp+'&quot;]').forEach(p=>{ p.hidden=(p.getAttribute(&quot;data-key&quot;)!==go); });
});
/* Carrossel de imagens (data-carousel) — montado de perfil.carousels[id] */
function fillCarousels(exp){
  const cars=(exp&amp;&amp;exp.carousels)||{};
  document.querySelectorAll(&quot;.step-item__content [data-carousel]&quot;).forEach(el=>{
    const id=el.getAttribute(&quot;data-carousel&quot;); const urls=((cars[id]||[])).filter(Boolean);
    if(!urls.length){ el.className=&quot;carousel carousel--empty&quot;; el.textContent=&quot;Carrossel sem imagens — adicione URLs no editor.&quot;; return; }
    el.className=&quot;carousel&quot;; el.setAttribute(&quot;data-i&quot;,&quot;0&quot;);
    const slides=urls.map(u=>'<div class=&quot;carousel__slide&quot;><img src=&quot;'+encodeURI(u)+'&quot; alt=&quot;&quot; loading=&quot;lazy&quot;></div>').join(&quot;&quot;);
    const ctrls=urls.length>1
      ? '<button class=&quot;carousel__nav carousel__prev&quot; type=&quot;button&quot; aria-label=&quot;Anterior&quot;>\u2039</button><button class=&quot;carousel__nav carousel__next&quot; type=&quot;button&quot; aria-label=&quot;Próxima&quot;>\u203A</button><div class=&quot;carousel__dots&quot;>'+urls.map((u,i)=>'<button class=&quot;carousel__dot'+(i===0?&quot; is-on&quot;:&quot;&quot;)+'&quot; type=&quot;button&quot; data-i=&quot;'+i+'&quot; aria-label=&quot;Imagem '+(i+1)+'&quot;></button>').join(&quot;&quot;)+'</div>'
      : &quot;&quot;;
    el.innerHTML='<div class=&quot;carousel__viewport&quot;><div class=&quot;carousel__track&quot;>'+slides+'</div></div>'+ctrls;
  });
}
function carouselGo(el,i){
  const n=el.querySelectorAll(&quot;.carousel__slide&quot;).length; if(!n) return;
  i=((i%n)+n)%n; el.setAttribute(&quot;data-i&quot;,i);
  const tr=el.querySelector(&quot;.carousel__track&quot;); if(tr) tr.style.transform=&quot;translateX(&quot;+(-i*100)+&quot;%)&quot;;
  el.querySelectorAll(&quot;.carousel__dot&quot;).forEach((d,k)=>d.classList.toggle(&quot;is-on&quot;,k===i));
}
document.addEventListener(&quot;click&quot;, function(e){
  const nav=e.target.closest(&quot;.carousel__nav&quot;), dot=e.target.closest(&quot;.carousel__dot&quot;);
  if(nav){ const el=nav.closest(&quot;.carousel&quot;); carouselGo(el, (+(el.getAttribute(&quot;data-i&quot;)||0))+(nav.classList.contains(&quot;carousel__next&quot;)?1:-1)); }
  else if(dot){ carouselGo(dot.closest(&quot;.carousel&quot;), +dot.getAttribute(&quot;data-i&quot;)); }
});

Store.load();
Calendar.init();
ExpCtrl.init();
initScrollSpy();
initReveal();
initHeroCanvas();

/* Form de atendimento (CRM): no iframe, resolve a action para o domínio do CRM (frame pai) */
$$(&quot;.crm-form&quot;).forEach(form=>{try{if(window.parent!==window){form.action=new URL(form.getAttribute(&quot;action&quot;),window.parent.location.origin).href;}}catch(e){}});
initRaFinder();
/* Sem pré-preenchimento de RA em cache ao abrir: o RA só é exibido após uma busca ativa. */
</script>
</body>
</html>
"></iframe>
</div>
